nodes.label: display (68px / 700)
nodes.rationale: Cover-slide title only. 68px bold, line-height 1.2, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, coloured brand-primary.

nodes.label: slide-title (42px / 700)
nodes.rationale: The single title on a content slide -- 'the only heading in the slide'. 42px bold, line-height 1.28, brand-primary. One title per slide is a structural rule, not just a size.

nodes.label: section-number (20px / 600)
nodes.rationale: The section badge, e.g. 'القسم 7.10'. Small but semibold so the number reads as a marker rather than as body copy.

nodes.label: Type scale (7 roles, projector-sized)
nodes.rationale: Seven roles: display 68/700, slide-title 42/700, section-number 20/600, body-lead 29/500, body 23/400, caption 18/400, mono 20/400. Every size is 'sized for a projector at the back of the room' -- the scale starts far larger than a screen-first scale would, which is also why the body floor is 22px and why grey text is banned.
